rows.en: Our time...!!
Our time...!!
Our time...!!
Time left: 0:56:21
Less than one hour remained on the "Survival Eleven" time limit!!
Whatever, we're getting out of here! Let's hurry to the Plasma Spark Tower!!
What's going on here!!
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What happened!?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's the matter?
God Gundam!! What's going on!?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
God Gundam!! What's going on!?
God Gundam!! What's wrong?
Look, a blast door. The way to the Plasma Spark Tower has been sealed off.
The blast door is sealed shut. Even the heroes' power can't break it down.
Damn it! Was I too careless!? At this rate, we're out of time!
What happened?
I fell into an enemy trap, and they made me waste my time...
...That's what happened to us too.
...That's what happened to us too.
...That's what happened to us too.
...That's what happened to us too.
...That's what happened to us too.
...That's what happened to us too!!
...Hey, that's the exact same thing that happened to us!!
...That's what happened to us too.
...The same thing happened to us, too.
...That's what happened to us too.
...That's what happened to us too.
...The same thing happened to us, too.
...That's what happened to us too.
What!? I see... So they were out to get us from the very start...!!
Is there no other way to the tower besides this one?
No, I've heard there are others. If we search this area, we might find one.
...Then, God Gundam, let's stick together for now.
In that case, God Gundam, let's team up for now.
Then we'd better act together, God Gundam.
Then we'd better act together, God Gundam.
All right! In that case, let's join forces! God Gundam!
In that case, let's join forces! God Gundam!
All right, then let's go look for it together, God Gundam!!
...Then, God Gundam, let's stick together for now.
In that case, God Gundam, let's work together!
In that case, God Gundam, let us act together here.
In that case, God Gundam, let us act together here.
In that case, God Gundam, let's work together on this!
All right, if that's how it is, let's go together! God Gundam!
...Understood. First, let's try the west side.
With God Gundam leading the way, the team set out to search for another route.
What the hell is going on!! Now we can't get to the tower!!
Locking out the heroes I could understand, but why us too...?
This one's sealed too!?
Yeah, it's sealed... Wait, you!! You're God Gundam!!
Tieren!! Calm down!!
Looks like you can't get in either?
You bastards... Now that I've found you, you're finished...
Hey! We don't have time to waste on these guys! Let's go!!
The blast door is sealed shut.
The blast door is sealed shut.
Same here. We'll just have to find another route.
It's a dead end, dammit!!
...It's blocked by a wall of ice.
What's the meaning of this!
This was supposed to be a shortcut to the tower!
They've sealed off every damn path!
If this one's no good... we've got nowhere else to try.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll run out of time and be disqualified.
This is a problem... At this rate, we'll run out of time and be disqualified.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll run out of time and be disqualified.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll run out of time and be disqualified.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll run out of time and be disqualified.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll run out of time and be disqualified.
Ain't this bad news... At this rate, we're gonna time out and get disqualified, y'know!?

notes.note: #0.74-0.76 continue the identical 'jikan ga!!' block from story_078 (#0.64-0.76); 0438.bla only calls +63 (#0.64, 00) here, so these may be unused variants. Identical English 'Our time...!!' (reaction to Alien Nackle's stalling).
Survival Eleven per glossary; source sets it in quotation brackets, kept as quotes.

0439/0441 leader-variant order from the Pt_Chara_Check index run (ids 6,7,9,10,1,2,3,4,5,11,12,14,15): Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O (Momotaros), W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero. Applies to #0.2-0.14, #0.20-0.32, #0.36-0.48 and 0441 #0.7-0.19. Wording fits: exclaiming RX (#0.7, #0.25), polite OOO/Mebius (#0.10/#0.13, #0.28/#0.31, #0.44/#0.47), rough Momotaros (#0.26, #0.42, 0441 #0.13), boku W (#0.27), formal Ultraman/Seven (#0.45/#0.46), rough Zero (#0.48).
No speaker in the script (name window closed): treated as narration.
'Ore ga amakatta' = was I too naive/careless; subject 'we' restored for 'jikan ga nai'.
'Jikan wo tsubusareta' = had his time wasted/eaten up by the enemy's stalling, as the heroes did with Alien Nackle.
Bare 'same as us' expanded to 'That's what happened to us too' (subject and verb restored).
Source trails off after 'us' (verb omitted); English restores 'out to get us' and keeps the trailing ellipsis. 'Yatsura' = Regis/the tournament organizers.
'Koko de atta ga hyakunen-me' (finally cornering a long-sought foe) rendered 'Now that I've found you, you're finished...'. Tieren addresses the heroes (and God Gundam) with 'temee-ra'.
#0.62 and 0440 #0.1: unspeakered narration, probably the examine text for the closed door.

Speaker id 276 has no CharacterName entry (shown as [#276]); story_080 #0.37 has Alien Iros crying out 'Kuuru-seijin!!' when this character dies, so it is Alien Kool (Ultraseven). Not in the glossary.
'Ate ga nai' = no other leads; subject 'we' restored.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader order from 0439/0441 Pt_Chara_Check index runs. #0.74-0.76 may be unused variants. Speaker [#276] (0441 #0.4) is Alien Kool by story_080 context; not in glossary. Time display rendered 'Time left: 0:56:21'.
